spans.s: मुर् vt. 6P (pres. मुरति) To entwine, to encircle, to surround.
मुर (I) m. Name of a demon slain by Kṛṣṇa, यियक्षमाणेनाहूतः पार्थेनाथ द्विषन्मुरम् Sis.ii.1.
मुर (II) n. Surrounding, enveloping.
मुर-अरि m. 1. an epithet of Viṣṇu or Kṛṣṇa, मुरारिमारादुपदर्शयंत्यसौ Git.G.i.; 2. name of the author of the Anargharāghava.
मुर-जित्, -द्विष्, -भिद्, -मर्दन, -रिपु, -वैरिन्, -हन् m. an epithet of Viṣṇu or Kṛṣṇa,
इति चटुलचाटुपटु
चारु सुरवैरिणो राधिकामधि वचनजातम् Git.G.x.

मुरज m. 1. A kind of drum, निर्ह्रादस्ते मुरज इव चेत् कंदरेषु ध्वनिः स्यात् Megh.i.56, संगीताय प्रहतमुरजाः ii.1, K.S.vi.40; 2. a stanza the letters of which can be arranged in the form of a drum.
मुरजा f. 1. Name of the wife of Kubera; 2. a great drum.
मुरज-फल m. the bread-fruit tree.
मुरज-बंध m. See (2) above.
मुरंदला f. Name of a river identified with the Narmadā.
मुरला f. Name of a river in the Keralas, मुरलामारुतोद्धूतमगमत्कैतकं रजः R.iv.55.
मुरली f. A flute, a pipe.
मुरली-धर, -वादन m. an epithet of Kṛṣṇa.
मुरली-धर, -वादन m. an epithet of Kṛṣṇa.

मुर्च्छ् vt. or vi. 1P (pp. मूर्त or मूर्च्छित; pres. मूर्च्छति) 1. To settle into a solid form; 2. to thicken, to become dense, तमसां निशि मूर्च्छतां निहंत्रे Vikr.iii.; 3. to faint away, to swoon, to become senseless, तेनामूर्च्छीदसौ क्षतः Bt.xv.55, मूर्च्छितजनाघातेन किं पौरुषम् Git.G.iii.; 4. to prevail against, to take effect on, न पादपोन्मूलनशक्ति रंहः शिलोच्चये मूर्च्छति मारुतस्य R.ii.34, छाया न मूर्च्छति मलोपहतप्रसादे शुद्धे तु दर्पणतले सुलभावकाशा Sak.vii.; 5. to become strong or powerful, to acquire vehemence, to increase, मुमूर्च्छ सहजं तेजो हविषेव हविर्भुजाम् R.x.79, मुमूर्च्छ सख्यं रामस्य (हरौ)R.xi.67; 6. to be frequent; 7. to sound loudly.With सम्-, to acquire vehemence, to be strong, to be powerful, to be intense, Kir.v.41.
मुर्मुर m. 1. A fire made of chaff, स्मरहुताशनमुर्मुरचूर्णतां दधुरिवाम्रवणस्य रकःकणाः Sis.vi.6, मुर्मुरमिव वर्षति समंतात् Vas.D.; 2. the god of love; 3. name of one of the horses of the sun.
मुर्व् vt. 1P (pres. मूर्वति) To tie, to bind.
मूर्ख (I) a. (f. र्खा) Stupid, dull, foolish, silly.
मूर्ख (II) m. 1. A fool, a blockhead, न तु प्रतिनिविष्ट मूर्खजनचित्तमाराधयेत् Bhartr.ii.6, तदामूर्खोऽस्मीति ज्वर इव मदो मे व्यपगतः ii.8; 2. a kind of bean.
मूर्ख (I) a. (f. र्खा) Stupid, dull, foolish, silly.
मूर्ख-भूय n. folly, stupidity.
मूर्च्छन (I) a. (f. नी) 1. Augmenting, strengthening; 2. causing insensibility (applied to one of the five arrows of the god of love).
मूर्च्छन (II) n. 1. Fainting, swooning; 2. vehemence, growth, increase; 3. calcining quick-silver with sulphur.

मूर्च्छना f. 1. Fainting, swooning; 2. the rise and fall of sounds in music (according to Mall.); 3. modulation, melody (according to others), भूयोभूयः स्वयमपि कृतां मूर्च्छनां विस्मरंती Megh.ii.23, वर्णानामपि मूर्च्छनांतरंगतं तारं विरामे मृदुम् Mrich.iii.
मूर्च्छन (I) a. (f. नी) 1. Augmenting, strengthening; 2. causing insensibility (applied to one of the five arrows of the god of love).
मूर्च्छा f. 1. Fainting, a swoon, K.D.ii.156, R.vii.44; 2. delusion; 3. a particular process in calcining metals.
मूर्च्छाल a. (f. ला) Fainted, insensible.
मूर्च्छाल a. (f. ला) Fainted, insensible.
मूर्च्छित a. (f. ता) 1. Fainted, insensible; 2. stupid, ignorant; 3. intensified; 4. increased, angmented; 5. filled with; 6. calcined.
मूर्च्छित a. (f. ता) 1. Fainted, insensible; 2. stupid, ignorant; 3. intensified; 4. increased, angmented; 5. filled with; 6. calcined.
मूर्त a. (f. र्ता) 1. Incarnate, corporeal, embodied, समरविजयलक्ष्मीः सैव मूर्ता बभूव R.vii.70, ii.69, K.S.vii.42; 2. fainted insensible; 3. stupid; 4. hard.
मूर्त a. (f. र्ता) 1. Incarnate, corporeal, embodied, समरविजयलक्ष्मीः सैव मूर्ता बभूव R.vii.70, ii.69, K.S.vii.42; 2. fainted insensible; 3. stupid; 4. hard.
मूर्ति f. 1. Anything which has a definite shape; 2. body, shape, R.iii.27; 3. manifestation, personification, embodiment, M.i.98; 4. an image, a statue, a figure; 5. beauty; 6. hardness.
मूर्ति-प m. a priest who is in charge of an idol.
मूर्ति-मत् a. 1. incarnate, embodied, शकुंतला मूर्तिमती च सत्क्रिया Sak.v., R.xii.64; 2. hard.

मूर्धन् m. 1. The head, मानोन्नतेनाप्यभिवंद्य मूर्ध्ना R.xvi.81; 2. the forehead; 3. top, summit, the most prominent part, त्वामासारप्रशमितवनोपप्लवं साधु मूर्ध्ना वक्ष्यत्यध्वश्रमपरिगतं सानुमानाम्रकूट Megh.i.17; 4. front, forepart, स किल संयुगमूर्ध्नि सहायतां मघवतः प्रतिपद्य R.ix.19; 5. the head, the chief.
मूर्धन्-अंत m. the crown of the head.
मूर्धन्-अभिषिक्त (I) a. consecrated, inaugurated, R.xvi.81.
मूर्धन्-अभिषिक्त (II) m. 1. a consecrated king; 2. a man of the Kṣatriya caste; 3. a minister; 4. particular mixed tribe said to have sprung from Brāhmaṇa father and a Kṣatriya mother.
मूर्धन्-अवसिक्त m. 1. a particular mixed tribe said to have sprung from Brāhmaṇa father and a Kṣatriya mother; 2. a consecrated king.
मूर्धन्-कर्णी, -कर्परी f. an umbrella.
मूर्धन्-कर्णी, -कर्परी f. an umbrella.
मूर्धन्-ज m. 1. the hair of the head, विकीर्णमूर्धजा K.S.iv.4; 2. the mane.
मूर्धन्-ज्योतिस् n. a crown of the head from which the soul is supposed to escape.
मूर्धन्-पुष्प m. the Śirīshā tree.
मूर्धन्-रस m. the scum of boiled rice.
मूर्धन्-वेष्टन n. a turban.
मूर्धन्य a. (f. न्या) 1. Being in or on the head; 2. cerebral (applied to the following letters, ऋ, ॠ, ट्, ठ्, ड्, ढ्, ण्, र्, and ष्); 2. preeminent, excellent.
मूर्धन्य a. (f. न्या) 1. Being in or on the head; 2. cerebral (applied to the following letters, ऋ, ॠ, ट्, ठ्, ड्, ढ्, ण्, र्, and ष्); 2. preeminent, excellent.
मूर्ध्वन् m. the same as मूर्धन् q.v.
मूर्वा(र्वी) f. A kind of creeper of which bowstrings are made.
मूर्वा(र्वी) f. A kind of creeper of which bowstrings are made.
